targetedParagraphRepairs.before: The spine has physiological curves, described as S-shaped from the side. Appearance alone does not diagnose spinal disease. Specifically report actually confirmed posture, pain and other conditions.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: The spine has physiological curves and is described as S-shaped when viewed from the side. Its appearance alone does not allow you to diagnose a spinal disease. Clearly communicate the posture, pain or other conditions that you have actually confirmed.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: This section teaches body mechanisms. Actual assistance follows condition, the individual care plan and practical training. Do not correct posture or start exercise from this explanation alone.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: This section explains how the body works. The actual method of assistance must follow the person’s condition, individual care plan and practical training. Do not use this explanation alone as a basis for correcting someone’s posture or starting exercise.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: The deltoid is around the shoulder and the pectoralis major on the front chest. The biceps brachii is at the front of the upper arm and the triceps brachii at the back. First establish front or back view when reading muscle diagrams.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: The deltoid is around the shoulder, and the pectoralis major is at the front of the chest. In the upper arm, identify the biceps brachii at the front and the triceps brachii at the back. Before reading a muscle diagram, first check whether it shows the front or the back of the body.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: [Learning comparison] Improved sound understanding with a hearing aid does not establish the entire auditory pathway as normal. Check accessible communication and wishes; consult professionals for necessary assessment and device adjustment.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: [Learning comparison] A person’s improved ability to understand sounds while using a hearing aid does not establish that their entire auditory pathway is normal. Check which communication methods they can understand and what they prefer. Consult the appropriate professionals about any necessary assessment or adjustment of the device.
